text:
samir: Quick check — PR #8422 (service: routing) is ready but blocked on RFC signoff. RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/2026-03-kv-routing. I added the canary plan to the PR description. Can someone from arch take a look?

alex: Looking now. One quick Q: will this change affect fallback routing to smaller models? If yes we should update the test matrix to include fallback verification.

jess: Pinged — can you add a short design summary in the RFC that calls out the fallback behavior and failure modes? I can't sign off until that's explicit. Also need perf numbers for 128 vs 512 seq lengths.

samir: Will add a "Fallback & perf" section today. Quick local numbers: ~35% p99 improvement for 512 after batching changes; I'll add the exact command and raw output to the RFC.

maria: FYI we have a dedicated canary window tomorrow at 14:00 PT. If signoff arrives before 13:30 PT I can schedule the canary slot.

sasha: Heads-up: CI flaky in tests/routing/test_kv_cache.py on linux-1 — failing assertion on cache hit counter. Not blocking arch review, but please fix before canary.

samir: Thanks — pushed a small test fix on top of the branch (force-pushed). Please re-run checks.

canary-bot: [CI] PR #8422 — linux-1: failed; linux-2: passed; unit: passed; integration: queued.

alex: Jess — any ETA on the RFC? If you can ack after Samir's update we can merge and get the canary scheduled.

jess: I'll review the updated RFC within a couple hours. If Samir includes the perf table and the fallback paragraph I can give arch ack.

samir: Added perf table, fallback paragraph, and the benchmark command: 
```bash
PYTEST_ADDOPTS=\"-k routing\" tox -e py3 -- tests/bench/bench_routing.py --seq-lens 128 512 --runs 5
```
Also added raw numbers and a short summary.

jess: Reviewed the update — looks good. Two tiny wording nits. Arch ack: +1 after Samir addresses the wording nits in the RFC. Please reply when done.

samir: Nits fixed and pushed. RFC updated. Replying here: addressed nits, ready to merge on ack.

jess: Arch signoff: +1. Leave a note in the PR and assign to Maria for canary.

maria: Assigned and scheduled canary at 14:00 PT tomorrow. I'll post results to #eng-releases once it runs.

alex: Thanks everyone. Samir — please update the PR description with the canary time so reviewers see it.

samir: Done — added canary time to PR description and will monitor the run. :thumbsup:
